call_points.text: Order intake for the custom ASIC business grew 50% QoQ with strong pipeline support.
High-voltage power products for AI data centers are on track to generate revenue next fiscal year.
DET 15% EBIT target pushed to H1FY28 from Q4FY27 as revenue ramp lags.
Order intake up 5.3% YoY; new business order intake up 64% YoY and 49% QoQ.
Nine large deals qualified in Q1, adding over $300 million to large-deal pipeline.
DET EBIT margin 13.2%, up 79 bps QoQ and 114 bps YoY on cost optimisation and FX.
DET gross margin 32.7%, down 13 bps QoQ but up 127 bps YoY after reclassification.
DET free cash flow ₹114 Cr, 80.5% conversion to normalised PAT, down 49% QoQ.
Kinetic debt is Singapore-based at roughly 1.25% plus spread, under 3% all-in.
Semiconductor breakeven guided for FY28; high-voltage product development consumes cash for four to five more quarters.
TAO Digital Solutions closing expected by August 2026; revenue contribution seen at $40-50 million.
Transportation and mobility grew 14.8% YoY in constant currency, fifth consecutive quarter of growth.
Energy vertical weakness may need one or two more quarters to rebound; strategic units fell 8.2% QoQ.
West Asia war and flying-hour concerns could hit aerospace revenue if disruption continues.
Buyback of 6.4 million shares at ₹1,125 each, ₹720 Cr, completed; promoters did not participate.
Acquisition funded primarily by debt, largely serviced from the target's free cash flow; EPS accretive after integration costs.
Target grew over 100% CAGR organically on a small base; management calls its forward assumptions conservative.
Cross-sell into Cyient accounts will take time; synergy is not a significant part of the earnout EBITDA.
Top 10 customers are probably around 60% of target revenue; no single customer concentration risk claimed.
Management incentive and retention scheme is less than 5% of deal value and paid only on outcomes.
A nonrecurring transaction charge will hit this quarter, smaller than the Q4 charge.
Breakeven still guided at late FY27 to early FY28, with a possible one-to-two-quarter shift.

operating_notes.text: Cyient semiconductor business delivered $7.2 million revenue in Q4 FY26, bringing full year revenue to $25.7 million.
Cyient Semiconductors launched seven 650V GaN power ICs in DPAK packages under a Navitas licence, its first commercial GaN family, with sampling expected by June 2026.
Cyient will provide a corporate guarantee and pledge 100% of its shares in Cyient Semiconductors to EAAA to secure ₹200 Cr of NCDs proposed to be issued by the subsidiary.
Cyient Semiconductors' equity financing with Edelweiss values the subsidiary at ~USD 500 Mn post-money, against FY26 revenue of $25.7 million.
Tao Digital Solutions Inc. had revenue of USD ~19.7 million in CY2023, USD ~50.3 million in CY2024 and USD ~79.1 million in CY2025, with ~3,500 employees.
Tao Digital's group includes entities in Canada, India, Taiwan, Greece, Germany, Czech Republic, Australia and a New Zealand branch under liquidation.
Cyient announced acquisition of Tao Digital Solutions Inc. for USD 218 Mn, funded primarily by debt.
Power ASSPs, including Kinetic, are roughly 50-60% of Cyient Semiconductors' business, with 50-60% gross margins.
Kinetic Technologies has about 250 products and 100 IP from its patent portfolio.
The ASIC pipeline is about $100 million of qualified opportunities, mostly industrial and medical.
TAO Digital's EBITDA margin is closer to 20%, versus 16-17% modelled for CY27 after integration haircut.
About 20% of TAO Digital's business is data digitization; the remaining 80% is platform and high-end data engineering.
Top 10 customers are probably around 60% of TAO Digital revenue, with no single customer concentration risk claimed.
DET order intake up 5.3% YoY; new business order intake up 64% YoY and 49% QoQ.
Large-deal pipeline over $300 million from nine deals qualified in Q1.
Semiconductor custom ASIC pipeline over $100 million; organic semiconductor revenue $7.5 million, up 5% QoQ.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,926.9 Cr (+0.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹54.8 Cr (-67.8% YoY).
Cyient board approved a ₹720 crore share buyback and reported FY26 DET revenue of ₹5,819 Cr.
Cyient Limited’s **Ravi Kumar Nukala (Dy. Company Secretary)** shared the Q4-FY26 earnings conference call recording on 23 April 2026 via the company website.
On 23 April 2026, Cyient reported Q4 FY26 DET revenue of $163.5 million and announced a ₹720 Cr share buyback.
2026-05-11: Cyient Semiconductors launched seven 650V GaN power ICs built on licensed Navitas technology, its first commercial GaN family, with sampling expected by June 2026.

2026-05-25: Cyient board approved a binding term sheet for EAAA to invest ₹300 Cr in Cyient Semiconductors — ₹200 Cr NCDs and ₹100 Cr CCD/CCPS — with a Cyient corporate guarantee and pledge of 100% of the subsidiary's shares.

2026-05-25: Cyient Semiconductors announced a strategic financing with Edelweiss funds — ~USD 10 Mn equity at a ~USD 500 Mn post-money valuation plus ~USD 20 Mn structured debt, subject to definitive agreements and closing conditions.
Cyient Limited corrected the recording link for its 26 May 2026 conference call on ‘Semiconductor Strategic Financing Transaction and Growth Roadmap’ via **Ravi Kumar Nukala, Dy. Company Secretary**.

2026-05-30: Cyient signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of US-based Tao Digital Solutions Inc. for an enterprise value of US$ 218 million (~9.5x CY27E EBITDA), with closing expected on or before 30 September 2026.
Cyient announced a definitive agreement to acquire US-based Tao Digital Solutions Inc. for USD 218 million on June 1, 2026.
Ravi Kumar Nukala (Dy. Company Secretary) announced the recording of the conference call on ‘CYIENT - TAO Digital Acquisition’ held on June 1, 2026, is available on Cyient’s website.
2026-06-01: Cyient Semiconductors signed a ₹300 Cr first external raise (₹200 Cr debt, ₹100 Cr equity) with EAAA Alternatives at a ₹4,650 Cr valuation.
Krishna Bodanapu declared on behalf of Cyient’s Promoter Group that no new encumbrances on shares existed as of 31 March 2026.
2026-06-08: Cyient released the transcript of its 1 June 2026 call on the TAO Digital acquisition, a $218 mn all-cash deal with about $130 mn upfront at 7.9x CY2025 EBITDA, funded mainly by debt.
Cyient completed the buyback of 64 lakh shares at ₹1,125 per share for ₹720 Cr, extinguishing them on July 15, 2026.
Cyient reported Q1FY27 results with revenue up 21.3% YoY to ₹2,075.7 Cr and PAT down 30.9% YoY to ₹108.7 Cr.
Cyient reported Q1FY27 results with DET revenue up 10.6% YoY to ₹1,540 Cr and EBIT margin expanding to 13.2%
Cyient's Q1FY27 earnings call pushed the DET 15% EBIT target to H1FY28 from Q4FY27 as constant-currency revenue fell 0.9% YoY, while DET EBIT margin rose 79 bps QoQ to 13.2%.
Cyient Limited's joint venture Infotech HAL Limited was dissolved by NCLT order on 17 August 2026 following completion of liquidation process.
Cyient outlined a three-year plan targeting 16%+ EBIT and 15%+ revenue CAGR by FY29, with DLM aiming for double-digit EBITDA margins.
Cyient received CCI approval for its acquisition of Tao Digital Solutions Inc. on 25 August 2026.
Cyient completed the acquisition of 100% stake in Tao Digital Solutions Inc. on 4 September 2026.
Cyient launched Intelligent Engineering Solutions (IES) and its CYiNGINE platform to accelerate technology-led growth and deliver measurable client outcomes.
Shareholders approved **Mr. Murali Yadama (DIN: 00034952)** as Non-Executive Independent Director via Postal Ballot (10-Oct-26) with 99.84% votes in favor.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,235 Cr (+25.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹121.4 Cr (-4.8% YoY).

Cyient Limited’s Board of Directors declared an interim dividend of ₹12 per equity share (240% on ₹5 face value) for FY 2026-27 on October 22, 2026, with a record date of October 28, 2026, and payment by November 17, 2026.
Cyient Board approved acquiring the remaining 49% stake in Cyient Solutions and Systems Private Limited for ₹1,00,000, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
Recording of the Earnings Conference Call for Q2–FY27, held 22 October 2026, is available on Cyient’s website.
